Class TrackEditor

java.lang.Object
com.group22.reportnow.listener.TrackEditor
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
public class TrackEditor extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
Finds open Java editors in BlueJ and monitors them for changes and uses TrackDocumentEdits to record editing activity.
